name: Susukinohara no Yakusoku
source:
Main character attends high school and suffers from nightmares every night. The strange thing in the nightmares is that girls there are from the real life around protagonist. Then one day a girl appears before him asking forgiveness for sending him into these dreams, but also asking for his help...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-may-2001-sapphism-no-gensou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角上高中，每天晚上都会做噩梦。噩梦中奇怪的是，主角周围都是来自现实生活的女孩。然后有一天，一个女孩出现在他面前，请求原谅让他陷入这些梦境，同时也请求他的帮助……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-may-2001-sapphism-no-gensou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
